name: pii-tokens
description: Masks CPF, CNPJ, email, phone and personal fields (table columns, JSON keys) in tool output before Claude sees them, with reversible tokens kept in an encrypted local vault.

allowed_email_domains.title: Allowed email domains
allowed_email_domains.description: Email domains left unmasked, such as your company's. Subdomains are included.

table_tools.title: Tools that return tables
table_tools.description: Tool name prefixes whose output is a psql-style table, masked by column name. Example: mcp__postgres__

dev_tool_names.title: Keep developer tool names
dev_tool_names.description: Leave name fields visible in package.json, lockfiles, kubectl, docker inspect, terraform, OpenAPI and GitHub repo JSON. Off by default: every name field is masked. When on, a one-word name inside a document shaped like one of those tools is not masked.

readable_fields.title: Readable fields
readable_fields.description: Fields that hold no person's name, as tool:path. Example: mcp__tracker__:**.items[].name keeps task titles. A CPF, CNPJ, email or phone inside the field is still masked. Empty by default.

masked_fields.title: Masked fields
masked_fields.description: Fields that hold personal data although their name does not say so, as tool:path. Example: mcp__tracker__:**.column_values[id=text_abc123].text masks one column. Wins over readable fields. Empty by default.

copy_read_request.title: Copy the read request to the clipboard
copy_read_request.description: When a pasted image with personal data blocks the prompt, copy the message that asks Claude to read it (and so masks it) to the clipboard, ready to paste. Replaces what the clipboard held. On by default.

terms.title: Terms to mask
terms.description: Words you decide are sensitive, such as a client's company name, one per entry. Matched in any case, with or without accents; terms of 6 letters or more also inside other words (domains, file names) and with a separator between letters. Become TERM# tokens. Empty by default.

mask_ip.title: Mask IP addresses
mask_ip.description: Replace IPv4 addresses with IP# tokens. 127.x, 0.0.0.0 and 255.255.x are kept. Off by default: server IPs in dev logs are common.
